chunks: From him, from Humayd ibn al-Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Muhammad ibn al-Ziyad, from Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who has a female slave, and she is uncovered, so he sees her or undresses her, without adding more than that, he said: She is not permissible for his son.
ai.seo_question: Does a father seeing his female slave naked prohibit her for his son?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the specific condition of 'illat al-jar' (exposure) in the prohibition of a father's concubine for his son, establishing that mere visual perception or undressing by the father suffices to render her haram for the son. It highlights the juristic nuance that physical consummation is not strictly required for this specific prohibition to take effect, relying instead on the father's act of uncovering her. This ruling is significant in Shia fiqh for distinguishing between different types of prohibitions arising from ownership and exposure.
